title: Stage 3: logs and a downstream call
summary: The book page now asks the pricing service for a price: trace it across the call, and log misses with the trace id.

steps.title: The last requirement
body: Prices move to their own service. `GET /books/{id:int}` now calls `GET /prices/{id:int}` (in this exercise it lives in the same app,
reached through `req.Scheme` and `req.Host`) and adds the price to its answer. On-call wants the call as a client span in the
same trace, and every miss logged with a template and the trace id.

steps.prompt: Which change makes the call to `/prices` appear as its own span, with the pricing server span as its child?
options: Passing the trace id in the query string
steps.explain: HttpClient already sends `traceparent`; the instrumentation adds the Client span between the two server spans.

steps.title: Price the book, log the misses
prompt: - in `GET /books/{id:int}`, for a found book, call it with an `HttpClient` from `IHttpClientFactory` (register `AddHttpClient()`)
- the **HttpClient instrumentation** on the tracer provider;
- the OpenTelemetry **logging** provider, and for a miss a **Warning** with the template **`Book {BookId} not found`**.
starter: var found = books.TryGetValue(id, out var title);
return found ? Results.Ok(new { id, title }) : Results.NotFound();

var found = books.TryGetValue(id, out var title);
return Results.Ok(new { id, title, price = price?.price });

hints: The handler becomes `async`; inject `HttpRequest req, IHttpClientFactory http, ILogger<Program> log`.
template: {{CODE}}
static class DojoTests
public static async Task Run(HttpClient http)
var r = await http.GetAsync("/books/1");
DojoWeb.Status("GET /books/1 answers 200", 200, r);
Dojo.Eq("price", "9.99", DojoWeb.Prop(await DojoWeb.Json(r), "price"));
var client = await DojoOtel.Span(a => a.Kind == ActivityKind.Client && DojoOtel.Tag(a, "url.full").Contains("/prices/1"));
await DojoOtel.Settle();
var pricing = DojoOtel.Spans.FirstOrDefault(a => a.DisplayName == "GET /prices/{id:int}");
var load = DojoOtel.Spans.FirstOrDefault(a => a.DisplayName == "load book" && client != null && a.TraceId == client.TraceId);
Dojo.Check("a client span for the price call", client is not null, "");
Dojo.Check("it is a child of load book", client is not null && load is not null && client.ParentSpanId == load.SpanId, "");
Dojo.Check("the pricing server span is its child", pricing is not null && client is not null && pricing.ParentSpanId == client.SpanId, "");
DojoWeb.Status("a miss is 404", 404, await http.GetAsync("/books/42"));
var miss = await DojoOtel.Span(a => a.DisplayName == "load book" && Equals(a.GetTagItem("app.book.id"), 42));
DojoOtel.Flush();
var log = DojoOtel.Logs.FirstOrDefault(l => l.Template == "Book {BookId} not found");
Dojo.Check("a Warning for the miss", log is not null && log.Level == Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.LogLevel.Warning, "Records: " + string.Join(" | ", DojoOtel.Logs.Select(l => l.Template)));
Dojo.Check("BookId is the int 42", log?.Attributes.GetValueOrDefault("BookId") is int dojoId && dojoId == 42, "");
Dojo.Eq("in the miss's span", miss?.SpanId.ToHexString(), log?.SpanId);
Dojo.Check("stage 2 still holds", DojoOtel.Points("app.book.lookups").Count == 2, "");
